rationale: The previous iteration's candidate was approved with stable geometry and sensor layout, and controller tuning aimed at reducing steering oscillations and improving completion time by lowering kp to 2.5, increasing kd to 8, and raising base_speed to 1.8. The evaluator feedback suggests testing a stronger integral gain ki=1.2 if oscillations persist, reducing base_speed to 1.8 if completion time worsens, and lowering kp to 2.0 if oscillations increase. Since the last candidate has not raced yet, I will cautiously increase ki to 1.2 to enhance integral action and reduce steady-state error, keeping kp at 2.5 and kd at 8 to maintain damping and proportional control. I will keep base_speed at 1.85, slightly above the previous 1.8, to push for faster completion time while monitoring stability. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_right' as it has yielded zero line loss events so far. I expect these changes to reduce oscillations and improve completion time without sacrificing stability. I request measurements including completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses.
